# Skull Splittur

Internal ID: BattleaxeSkullSplittur | Type: Axe | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x15, Iron x45 | Attack speed: 0.84 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.5 range, 30 angle, 1.0 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -15%

# Introduction

The Skull Splittur is a two-handed Axe. Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo (Wide swing, wide swing, vertical overhead) with double damage on the last hit, 1.5x staggering and no multitarget penalty. Its faster secondary attack deals 0.5x damage and 4x staggering.

## Notes

• The first hit is very slow. The last two hits take about the same time, while in total dealing triple damage.
• General combo starter is the secondary into the primary.
